originalTitle: US hires over 2k video gamers as air traffic controllers
content: Video gamers are in demand to help patrol the nation's skies.U.S. Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy said in a recent social media post that the federal agency's recruitment campaign to recruit gamers as air traffic controllers has been a "game changer" for the Federal Aviation Administration. The FAA hired more than 2,000 video gamers to train as air traffic controllers, meeting 94% of its hiring goal, according to the Transportation Department. Another 2,000-plus candidates are in the hiring pipeline, Duffy added. Why video gamers?When Duffy announced the initiative in April, he acknowledged that the Transportation Department needed to extend its reach to recruit prospective air traffic controllers. "A lot of what they do playing games ... is what they do ... controlling traffic in the air," Duffy told CBS News senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave in an interview on Tuesday at New Jersey's Newark Liberty International Airport. Duffy added that many current trainees started out as gamers. Only about 25% of controllers hold a traditional college degree, while former controllers note that gaming requires many of the same skills that air traffic controllers use on the job, such as thinking quickly, staying focused and managing multiple sources of information as they guide more than 80,000 flights to their destinations daily. How much do controllers earn?In 2024, the most recent year for which federal data is available, the median annual wage for air traffic controllers was $144,580. But pay varies widely depending on a controller's experience and where they work. Less experienced controllers at smaller airports earn close to $60,000 a year on average, according to aviation experts. A December report from the U.S. Government Accountability Office pointed to a major shortage of air traffic controllers, warning that it could lead to more flight delays or cancellations. A government shutdown late last year also turned some workers away from the profession, as controllers â who under the law are considered essential personnel â were forced to work without pay. Before someone qualifies to train at the FAA's Air Traffic Controller Academy in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, job candidates must undergo a rigorous application process. Among the criteria to become a controller are to hold U.S. citizenship, be under the age of 31 and pass the FAA air traffic pre-employment tests. Aspiring controllers must also pass an exam that the FAA says predicts candidates' "aptitude to be an air traffic controller." Within a week, they are notified if they have passed. Historically, fewer than 10% of applicants met the FAA's requirements to work as an air traffic controller and gain admission to the agency's training program.
chineseTitle: 美国雇佣超过 2000 名视频游戏玩家担任空中交通管制员
chineseContent: 电子游戏玩家需要帮助巡逻国家的天空。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 在最近的社交媒体帖子中表示，联邦机构招募游戏玩家担任空中交通管制员的招聘活动对联邦航空管理局来说是“游戏规则改变者”。据美国运输部称，FAA 雇佣了 2,000 多名视频游戏玩家作为空中交通管制员进行培训，完成了 94% 的招聘目标。达菲补充说，另外 2,000 多名候选人正在招聘中。为什么是视频游戏玩家？当达菲在四月份宣布这一举措时，他承认交通部需要扩大其范围来招募未来的空中交通管制员。 “他们玩游戏所做的很多事情……就是他们所做的……控制空中交通，”达菲周二在新泽西州纽瓦克自由国际机场接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻高级交通记者克里斯·范·克利夫采访时说道。达菲补充说，许多目前的学员都是从游戏玩家开始的。只有大约 25% 的管制员拥有传统的大学学位，而前管制员指出，游戏需要许多与空中交通管制员在工作中使用的相同技能，例如快速思考、保持专注以及管理多个信息源，因为他们每天引导超过 80,000 架航班飞往目的地。管制员的收入是多少？2024 年，即可获得联邦数据的最近一年，空中交通管制员的年薪中位数为 144,580 美元。但薪酬差异很大，具体取决于控制员的经验和工作地点。据航空专家称，小型机场经验不足的管制员平均年薪接近 6 万美元。美国政府问责办公室 12 月的一份报告指出
